Bengal STF Busts Pakistan-Linked JeM Plot Targeting Protest, Minister

West Bengal's Special Task Force (STF) arrested Hamim Mondal, a suspected Jaish-e-Mohammed (JeM) operative, and his associate Arpita Sarkar. The STF alleges Mondal planned to target West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari and sabotage a student protest at Jantar Mantar. Investigators claim Mondal intended to infiltrate the protest in police uniform and use a honey-trap plot. His girlfriend's social media activity reportedly led the STF to him. Two individuals have been booked under the UAPA.
